newsitem.title: USA: BolsWessanen to buy Dean's Ready Foods.
newsitem.headline: BolsWessanen to buy Dean's Ready Foods.

text.p: Koninklijke BolsWessanen NV said on Tuesday in a statement received here that Crowley Foods Inc, its eastern dairy division in the United States, agreed to acquire Ready Foods Inc of Philadelphia, a subsidiary of Dean Foods Inc.
BolsWessanen, based in the Netherlands, is an international food and beverages group. It said Ready Foods generates $25 million sales and has 85 employees.
With this transaction, Crowley Foods broadens its manufacturing capabilities and product range from fresh dairy products and ice cream to ultra pasteurized extended shelf life dairy products.
Dean Foods was not immediately available for comment.
